across_options.issue: brand/constitution.md Article 14.4 and brand/ledger.md D2: the options do not isolate typefaces. B removes the visible curved line texture from the offer field; A and C retain it. Texture is the separate open decision D5.

The surrounding presentation ground changes: A and B have cool blue-gray gutters; C has warmer neutral-gray gutters. The white phone boundaries and content positions also shift slightly. Neither change belongs to D2.
The item photography is not held exactly constant. C changes small details of the jacket folds and shoe laces/crop compared with A and B. These changes are unrelated to typefaces.
The lime band below $31.40 is shorter in B than in A and C. This may follow the changed text metrics, but it changes the visible amount of color as well as the typography.
